channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: Sign in with W3BS: accounts on w3bs.org and `w3bs login`
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: w3bs.org accounts: passkeys or a password, an emailed link as the fallback, w3bs login for the CLI, and Sign in with W3BS for apps over OAuth 2.1.

item.title: w3bs: one command line for the open Web
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The w3bs CLI is live: one command line for the open Web. w3bs packages lists 65 dev and agentic CLIs, each installed with its publisher's curl | sh, and w3bs update keeps them current.

item.title: Free ebook: Software Engineering in the Agentic Era
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A free, open-source field guide to building software with a fleet of AI coding agents. PDF, EPUB and HTML.

item.title: CoinPay Finances: due soon, recurring charges and a daily summary
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: CoinPay Finances now lists what is due soon across every bank and card, with recurring charge detection, card due days, a daily summary email and MCP tools.

item.title: OutreachGraph now runs Hunter’s 12-month outreach planner by itself
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: OutreachGraph 0.10.0 runs Hunter's 12-month outreach planner on its own: verify before sending, a 2% bounce gate, one contact per company, A/B tests that end, business hours, and a play per month built from engagement.

item.title: Real emoji and icons in your terminal, even over SSH and tmux
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: qc and hqtui 0.9.0 draw our OpenEmoji and OpenIcon artwork as real images in Kitty and Ghostty, even over SSH and tmux.

item.title: hqterm desktop 0.4: now on Mac and Windows
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: hqterm desktop 0.4.0 adds a Mac app for Apple silicon and Intel and a Windows installer: tabs, splits, HD emoji, inline images and ssh sessions that never drop.

item.title: The Profullstack webring: 72 sites, five links, and how to start your own
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Every Profullstack site carries << Profullstack >> in its footer. How the ring works, anonymous voting, how a site joins, and how to make and run a webring of your own on RSS Amplifier.

item.title: hqterm 0.3: sessions that never drop, on every machine you own
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: hqterm 0.3: persistent, shareable terminal sessions over plain ssh that survive sleep and network changes, with Linux, macOS and Windows hosts and Tailscale built in.

item.title: OutreachGraph now finds ideas worth building and selling
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: OutreachGraph's Idea Generator reads Reddit, Ask HN and founder case studies, scores each idea on demand, proof people pay and competition, and hands the best to chovy.com to build.
